verdict.rationale: The docs describe a publishing flow. You can publish a server already deployed elsewhere by entering its public HTTPS URL, local stdio servers are distributed as pre-built MCPB bundles, and a static server card covers cases where scanning fails. Published servers get a dedicated page where users can discover, try and install them, plus deep links that auto-configure clients and CLI registry search. Community scans of the top 100 registry servers confirm the registry hosts many third-party servers. Missing for 10: hands-on corroboration of the publish flow itself, and documentation of updating or versioning published servers.
